sentence: Voting commenced on 9 December 2015, and closed on 22 January 2016. [ 1 ] Voters nominated ten songs that were released between December 2014 and November 2015 and submitted them through the Triple J website.
Any song that premiered between December 2015 and November 2016 was eligible for 2016's Hottest 100.

Triple J published a list of 1,909 eligible songs on their 2016 Voting List. [ 3 ] Voting commenced on 12 December 2016, as announced by Dr Karl Kruszelnicki in a nature mockumentary depicting a live music event.

Any song that premiered between December 2016 and November 2017 was eligible for 2017's Hottest 100.

Voting opened 12 December 2017, shortly after the end of the eligibility period. [ 4 ] Several presenters made their votes public. [ 5 ] The artists most often voted for by Triple J presenters were: Kendrick Lamar , Lorde , Gang of Youths , and Baker Boy .
Any song that was released for the first time between 1 December 2017 and 30 November 2018 is eligible for 2018's Hottest 100.

Voting opened on 10 December 2018, as announced by Liam Stapleton in a crime mockumentary . [ 3 ] Several artists and presenters, including Billie Eilish , Tash Sultana , Amy Shark and Anderson .Paak , made their votes public. [ 4 ] The artists most often voted for by Triple J presenters were The Presets , Kwame , Rüfüs Du Sol , and G Flip .
Once voting closed, Triple J announced on 25 January that a total of 2.758 million votes had been cast, breaking the previous year's record by 14%.

Any song initially released between 1 December 2018 and 30 November 2019 was eligible for 2019's Hottest 100. [ 3 ] Voting opened on 16 December 2019. [ 4 ] Many artists and presenters made their votes public—out of 23 Triple J presenters, the artists they voted for most often were Julia Jacklin , Sampa the Great , and Thelma Plum .
Any song initially released between 1 December 2019 and 30 November 2020 was eligible for 2020's Hottest 100.
Any song initially released between 1 December 2020 and 30 November 2021 was eligible for the 2021 Triple J Hottest 100.

[ 4 ] For songs to be eligible in the 2024 countdown, they must have been released between 1 December 2023 and 30 November 2024.
Voting began on 10 December 2024, and will end on 20 January 2025.
